events.text: Diagnosis: the existing req_2511 logs only cover the GRAB (mouse-down) half, which works — val=32 on every click PROVES the commit half is broken: the mouse-up commit is the only hop that writes the value into React state, and the per-frame re-render clobbers the engine's write back to 32 when it's lost. Instrumented every hop of the commit chain (engine endSliderDrag -> JS dispatch -> registry -> PaintToolbar onCommit -> AppFrame onBrush -> ModelView.setBrush) plus the React sliderValue prop-write clobber itself. One click now names the broken link. Commit 1beb7b69e. JS logs hot-reload; Zig logs need a rebuild.
